%s. 우리 부락 피였다.\n오늘 밤 불을 크게 피운다.\n조상이 길을:
%s. Blood of our clan.
Tonight we burn a big fire.
So the ancestors find the way.
Orcs build the fire high
for their dead.
%s stood in front to the end.
…Went like an orc.
Still. It hurts.
Keep back meat for %s.
Tonight we set a bowl
at the empty place.
One empty bowl
is louder than any wailing.
%s. Different blood.
But held the same wall.
That makes us one clan.
%s showed no fear.
I saw. I am witness.
I'll tell the ancestors so.
An orc's testimony
outlasts a gravestone.
%s. Say the name loud.
Say it soft,
and the ancestors won't hear.
The walls are torn up!
Innkeeper, give me timber.
Orc hands are big.
The lodge bled.
A house is a clan too.
…Tonight we hold harder.
I see stars through the roof.
Good stars.
…Still. We patch it.
거미 여왕을 잡았다고?!\n오늘은 잔치다, 주인!\n고기 굽자!:
You killed the spider queen?!
Tonight we feast, Innkeeper!
Roast the meat!
Nivella has fallen.
I carve that name in bone.
Next to yours, Innkeeper.
The north nest is quiet.
…You fought big, Innkeeper.
Even an orc bows.
Bowing, they say.
Their head's still above mine.
어젯밤, 노래 같았다!\n북소리, 비명, 쇳소리.\n…조상도 들었을 거다:
Last night was a song!
Drums, screams, steel.
…The ancestors heard it too.
놈들이 끝도 없었다.\n도끼날이 다 나갔다.\n…주인, 숫돌 있나?:
They never stopped coming.
My axe edge is gone.
…Innkeeper, got a whetstone?
Bandages look more urgent
than a whetstone.
We got through a big night.
Big night, big meal after.
That is orc law.
Fog is a coward.
It hides its face.
…You fight face to face.
I shouted in the fog.
Loud. So our side knew me.
…Lost my voice.
The ancestors called fog
the breath of the dead.
…Last night's breath was cold.
남은 밤이 손가락 둘.\n…약속한 밤은 끝까지 선다.\n오크는 반만 안:
Two fingers of nights left.
…I stand every night I swore.
Orcs don't do half.
Eyes that hold a twelve-night
promise as hard as bone.
The end is in sight, Innkeeper.
When it's done, a great feast.
…Let's be alive for it.
The twelfth night is near.
I'm choosing words for the ancestors.
…Short. Loud.
No meat in the larder?!
You don't say that
to an orc, Innkeeper.
Someone has to say it.
…The larder says it.
The soup is clear.
The light shines right through.
…I'll go fetch meat.
If there's no meat,
give them my share.
…Ah. Mine's gone too.
Nobody hurt!
A good night, Innkeeper!
Sit. Eat with me.
"Eat with me"
is how orcs say hello.
A quiet night. Good.
…My axe is bored.
Just a little.
Everyone's alive.
The ancestors watched the lodge.
…Tonight's supper is thanks.
